newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures rise on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures rise on short-covering.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended firmer across the board on Tuesday, lifted by private investors' short-covering ahead of the close, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.8 yen to 1.4 yen per kg higher. Benchmark May contract was up 1.1 yen at 142.7 yen.

The market was spurred mainly by technical factors amid a dearth of fresh incentives. Prices drifted within tight ranges for most of the day, as the yen's weaker tendency was offset by lower overseas markets. "Market players were basically looking for clear direction," one trader said.
